title: 100+ Camera HD Surveillance Network
subtitle: A wide-area HD camera network with control rooms, video walls and remote tower sites, run on our SVMS software
headline: More than 100 HD cameras over microwave, satellite, fibre and WiMax links, with control rooms, video walls and remote control of tower camera sites
photoAlt: Control-room video wall showing a live road camera
need: The client needed live HD video from more than 100 cameras spread over a wide area, brought into control rooms over whatever link each site could get: microwave, satellite, fibre or WiMax.
Remote tower sites had to be powered and controlled without staff on site, and each operator had to see only the cameras they were authorised to view.
role: A follow-on project from the command-and-control programme. SciFlair directed the programme: requirements, system design and integration, vendor management, factory acceptance and client sign-off, with SVMS, our own video management software, at its core.
built: More than 100 HD PTZ cameras on towers and rooftops, each with its own wireless or wired link
A mixed backhaul over microwave, satellite, fibre and WiMax, carrying every stream to the control rooms
CCTV control rooms with video walls driven by SVMS wall players
Remote power and control of tower camera sites, so faults are handled without a site visit
SVMS video management: live and recorded viewing, PTZ control, recording and per-operator camera rights
builtScope: Fixed tower and rooftop sites, control rooms and video walls, all on one SVMS system.

delivery.title: Requirements and design
delivery.text: Camera sites, link types and control-room needs captured and turned into one system architecture.

delivery.title: Vendor management and integration
delivery.text: Cameras, radios and control-room equipment from several vendors integrated under SVMS.

delivery.title: Validation and transition
